2608.20988.title: Jacobian-guided Noise Injection for Quantization Robustness in Large Language Models
2608.20988.paper_summary: Quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs) is often hindered by the sensitivity of the self-attention mechanism to discretization errors. We identify the softmax operator as a bottleneck for quantization stability due to its sensitivity to outliers and state-dependent Jacobian. We theoretically establish that suppressing the norm of this Jacobian helps in bounding quantization-induced performance degradation. Based on this, we propose Jacobian-Guided Noise Injection, a training strategy that injects zero-mean Gaussian noise into pre-attention logits, with variance derived directly from the Jacobian Frobenius norm. Unlike prior approaches that rely on heuristic or penalise jacobian directly, our method provides a way to identify the optimal noise variance based on the local attention sensitivity. We evaluate the method on SOTA LLM architectures, where it demonstrates improved robustness over popular PTQ methods. Empirical analysis reveals that the proposed method gives up to +37% relative gains on Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K for SigLIP and improves relative perplexity by upto 40% on WikiText for language models in low bit quantisation settings, proving the efficacy of the approach.
2608.20988.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）的量化常常受到自注意力機制對離散化誤差的敏感性所阻礙。<lb/>我們確定softmax運算子是量化穩定性的瓶頸，因為它對異常值和狀態依賴的雅可比矩陣敏感。<lb/>我們從理論上證明，抑制這個雅可比矩陣的範數有助於限制量化引起的性能下降。<lb/>基於此，我們提出了雅可比引導噪聲注入，一種訓練策略，將均值為零的高斯噪聲注入到自注意力前的logits中，其方差直接來自雅可比的弗羅貝尼烏斯範數。<lb/>與依賴啟發式或直接懲罰雅可比的先前方法不同，我們的方法提供了一種基於局部注意力敏感性識別最佳噪聲方差的方式。<lb/>我們在最先進的LLM架構上評估該方法，結果顯示其在流行的PTQ方法中表現出更好的穩健性。<lb/>實證分析顯示，所提出的方法在ImageNet-1K的SigLIP上提供了高達+37%的Top-1準確率相對增益，並在低位量化設置中對語言模型的WikiText相對困惑度提高了高達40%，證明了該方法的有效性。
